props.title: Money Moves on Hope. Not Guarantees.

left.label: STATUS QUO
left.title: {c:#991b1b}Local Services Today{/c}
points: {c:#ea580c}01{/c}  No Discovery Hub — No single platform to find nearby specialists, dispatch errands, or rent an extra set of hands.
{c:#ea580c}02{/c}  No Payment Guarantee — Providers complete work with no assurance of getting paid.
{c:#ea580c}03{/c}  Upfront Client Risk — Clients pay before seeing results, with zero recourse if work fails.
{c:#ea580c}04{/c}  Word-of-Mouth Pricing — No reliable way to discover, benchmark, or compare local service costs.

right.label: THE GAP
right.title: {c:#64748b}Guarantee?{/c}
points: {c:#94a3b8}→  No escrow. No contracts. No recourse.{/c}
{c:#94a3b8}→  Trust is fragmented across calls and WhatsApp.{/c}
{c:#94a3b8}→  A ₦4T+ market running entirely on hope.{/c}

slides.notes: Frame the pain: providers and clients both carry risk. The status quo has no guarantees.

items.title: Funds Locked
items.body: Client's payment is locked in a Solana escrow PDA before work begins.

items.title: Work Verified
items.body: Provider completes the task. Client reviews and approves.

items.title: Payment Released
items.body: Funds release to provider automatically. Disputes get fair on-chain splits.

slides.notes: Three steps. The user never sees the chain — they just feel the guarantee.

items.title: {c:#64748b}Post & Pay{/c}
items.body: {c:#94a3b8}01 · CLIENT SIDE — Post a task with budget and location. Pay in naira via card or bank transfer.{/c}

items.title: {c:#ea580c}Escrow & Match{/c}
items.body: {c:#64748b}02 · REACH PLATFORM — Server-side relayer locks funds in Solana escrow. PostGIS matches nearby providers.{/c} {c:#ea580c}CUSTODIAL RELAYER{/c}

items.title: {c:#64748b}Work & Earn{/c}
items.body: {c:#94a3b8}03 · PROVIDER SIDE — Accept jobs, complete work, receive USDC or cash out to naira bank account.{/c}

slides.notes: Three zones. The middle zone is where Reach earns its keep — escrow plus geospatial matching.

items.title: 2.5% — Task Creation Fee
items.body: Charged when escrow is funded. Flows to protocol fee vault.

items.title: 5% — Platform Commission
items.body: Deducted from provider payout on task completion.

items.title: 10% — Cancellation Fee
items.body: Charged when a client cancels an active task.
